battle.name: 胡奈之戰
battle.brief: 西元630年，穆罕默德率一萬二千人自麥加出發，討伐赫瓦辛、薩卡夫等部族聯軍。聯軍預伏山谷，以拋石與襲擊迫前鋒潰散，先知一度被圍；卡里德率騎兵繞出隘口反擊伏兵，戰局才逆轉，聯軍崩潰。卡面斯巴達長矛未到過阿拉伯半島，但它代表的密集步兵與側翼騎兵之爭，正是此役的骨架。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 這是一場發生在伊斯蘭曆8年（西元630年）、希賈茲腹地胡奈山谷的部落聯軍對決。穆斯林一方是剛在麥加取得政權的先知共同體：作戰主體是麥地那的輔士與遷士，新近歸附的麥加古萊什人湊成約兩千人的補充兵員，全軍總數傳統記載作一萬二千。指揮系統極簡：穆罕默德居中，頭銜是「真主的使者」兼全軍統帥；艾布·伯克爾與歐麥爾守在中軍旗旁，阿里·本·艾比·塔利卜執黑旗為全軍之幟，叔父阿巴斯寸步不離先知；最下層的指揮權落到各部族首領手裡，輔士首領艾布·卡塔達與艾布·蘇福揚各領一部。阿里的旗隊由三百名騎駱駝的先鋒開路，卡里德·本·瓦利德率騎兵團擔任側翼迂回的打擊力量。敵方是以赫瓦辛為核心的部落聯盟：薩卡夫佔據塔伊夫這座要塞城市，奈斯爾、朱沙姆、賽阿德·本·巴克拉、希拉勒、阿米爾·本·阿米爾、阿夫·本·阿米爾與蘇萊姆各部在歐塔斯集結，由馬利克·本·阿夫夫說服合流並策劃伏擊，老將杜萊德·本·西瑪坐鎮中軍，艾布·艾威爾參與其事。聯軍總數傳統記載作兩萬，並把家眷、牲畜與攻城器械一併帶進山谷。
countriesEn: This was a clash between a tribal confederation and a newly formed coalition in the Hunayn valley in the interior of the Hijaz, dated to 8 AH (630 CE). The Muslim side was the community of the Prophet, which had just taken control of Mecca: the body of the army was made up of the Ansar of Medina and the emigrants from Mecca, with about two thousand newly converted Meccans added as a supplement, and the traditional sources give the total as twelve thousand men. The command structure was minimal. Muhammad held the centre, with the titles of the Messenger of God and commander of the whole army; Abu Bakr and Umar ibn al-Khattab stood beside the standard in the middle; Ali ibn Abi Talib carried the black banner as the emblem of the entire host, and the Prophet's uncle Abbas never left his side. The lowest tier of command lay with the chiefs of each tribal contingent, the Ansari leaders Abu Qatada and Abu Sufyan each commanding a division. Ali's standard was preceded by a vanguard of three hundred men riding camels, and Khalid ibn al-Walid led the cavalry that was to strike the enemy in the flank. The enemy was a confederation built around the Hawazin: the Thaqif held the fortified city of Taif, while the contingents of Nasr, Jusham, Sa'd bin Bakr, Hilal, Amr bin Amir, Awf bin Amir and Sulaym gathered at Autas, where Malik ibn 'Awf persuaded them to join together and planned the ambush. The old warrior Durayd ibn al-Simma held the centre, and Abu al-A'war took part. The confederation is traditionally given as twenty thousand men, and they brought their families, their livestock and their siege equipment into the valley with them.
people: 留下姓名的多數屬於勝方。穆罕默德是全軍統帥，也是這場仗的決策核心：他決定在麥加陷落後兩週內追擊赫瓦辛，兵敗後下令全軍回身重整，又以一句「我是真主的使者，是安拉的兒子穆罕默德」穩住人心；傳說他抓一把土撒向敵陣，說「願你們的臉蒙羞」，敵軍目不能視。艾布·伯克爾當時是麥地那社群的主事者，戰後在戰利品分配上為艾布·卡塔達仗義。歐麥爾·本·哈塔卜居中軍，保衛先知。阿里·本·艾比·塔利卜執黑旗，潰退時整軍再戰，是此役的關鍵人物之一。叔父阿巴斯·本·阿卜杜·穆塔利卜與其子法德爾·阿巴斯守在先知身邊；吾薩馬·本·宰德、艾布·蘇福揚·本·哈里卜亦在護衛之列；輔士艾曼·本·歐拜德為掩護先知而戰死。艾布·卡塔達·安薩里在勝後爭取戰利品時與艾布·伯克爾有一段著名對話。卡里德·本·瓦利德是全場最關鍵的戰術角色：他在主力重新站住之後率騎兵由谷後隘道繞出，攻擊伏兵背側，扭轉戰局。敵方留下姓名的有馬利克·本·阿夫夫（設伏者）、杜萊德·本·西瑪（馳名的老練騎士，在逃往納赫拉的路上被拉比亞·本·拉菲追上殺死），以及艾布·艾威爾。
peopleEn: Most of the names that survive belong to the winning side. Muhammad was the commander of the whole army and the decision-making centre of the battle: he chose to strike at the Hawazin within two weeks of the fall of Mecca, ordered the army to turn about and reform after the first defeat, and steadied his men with the words 'I am the Messenger of God, I am Muhammad, the son of Abdullah'; the tradition says he took up a handful of earth and threw it at the enemy crying that their faces should be covered with shame, and that the enemy's eyes were clouded with dust. Abu Bakr was at that time the leading figure of the community at Medina, and after the victory he spoke up for Abu Qatada over the division of the spoils. Umar ibn al-Khattab held the centre of the line and guarded the Prophet. Ali ibn Abi Talib carried the black banner, reformed the broken ranks during the retreat, and was one of the decisive personalities of the day. The Prophet's uncle Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib and his son Fadl ibn Abbas stayed at the Prophet's side; Usama ibn Zayd and Abu Sufyan ibn al-Harith were among the guards as well, and the Ansari Ayman ibn Ubayd was killed while covering the Prophet. Abu Qatada al-Ansari is remembered for the exchange with Abu Bakr over the spoils after the victory. Khalid ibn al-Walid was the single most important tactical figure on the field: once the main body had re-formed, he led the cavalry out through the pass behind the valley and struck the ambushers in the rear, turning the battle. On the enemy side the names that remain are Malik ibn 'Awf, who laid the ambush; Durayd ibn al-Simma, the famous old and experienced horseman, killed on the road to Nakhlah by Rabi'a ibn Rafi'; and Abu al-A'war.
kits: 卡面上這根斯巴達長矛（dory）並沒有出現在胡奈山谷。它屬於希臘重裝步兵的裝備：兩米左右的木槍，槍尾帶銅套，槍尖是套柄的矛頭，配套還有圓盾（aspis）、束身皮甲或亞麻甲、青銅頭盔與短劍。把它放進這場戰役的裝備表，理由不是年代巧合，而是它所代表的那一套作戰邏輯：密集的步兵線、靠得住的站位，以及配合正面糾纏的側翼衝擊。胡奈真正用上的兵器則是阿拉伯式的：步兵持鐵矛與標槍，配小圓皮盾或大型曲面羊角形大盾（uraq），部分兵員用短複合弓；近身有阿拉伯彎刀與短劍；薩卡夫與赫瓦辛的戰士多穿皮甲、戴頭巾或頭盔，舊有的赤身搏鬥傳統仍在。機動方面，駱駝是關鍵物資：前鋒三百人騎駱駝作戰，聯軍方面還有駱駝背上的轎式座騎（hidja）與成群的牛羊隨軍，改乘的馬匹在追擊中發揮作用。城防與攻城器械也在名單上：胡奈堡壘有壕溝與石砌高台，守方備有投石機（man'a）與撞擊拋射兩用的攻城器（sad'），正是其後圍塔伊夫時用來對付羊角形大盾的同一類器械；胡奈堡內的攻城器與糧秣，戰後成了穆斯林手中第一批攻城物資。
kitsEn: The Spartan dory on the card did not stand in the valley of Hunayn. It belongs to the equipment of the Greek hoplite: a wooden shaft about two metres long with a bronze butt-spike and a socketed spearhead at the head, worn with the round shield (aspis), a corselet of leather or linen, a bronze helmet and a short sword. It belongs in the equipment table of this battle not because of any coincidence of dates but because of the body of tactical doctrine it stands for: a dense line of infantry, positions that hold, and a flank blow delivered while the front is engaged. The weapons actually used at Hunayn were Arab ones. The foot carried iron spears and javelins, with small round leather shields or large curved horn-shaped shields (uraq), and some of them used short composite bows. Hand-to-arm fighting was done with the Arab curved sword and short blades. The warriors of the Thaqif and the Hawazin generally wore leather armour with headcloths or helmets, and the old tradition of fighting stripped of armour was still alive. Mobility turned on the camel: three hundred men of the vanguard fought mounted on camels, the confederates also had howdah-style mounts (hidja) on their camels and herds of cattle and sheep came with them, and the horses switched to during the pursuit did their work there. Fortifications and siege engines are on the list as well: the fortress at Hunayn had a ditch and a stone-built platform, the defenders had a stone-throwing engine (man'a) and a combined battering and throwing siege engine (sad'), the same class of machine later used against the horn-shaped shields in the siege of Taif. The siege engines and stores in the fortress of Hunayn became, after the fight, the first siege material the Muslims got their hands on.
tactics: 這場仗的流程可以拆成五段。第一段是行軍：麥加陷落後約兩週，穆斯林大軍自麥加出發，沿通往塔伊夫的路走進希賈茲丘陵，走了三、四天，於伊斯蘭曆10月10日夜抵達胡奈。聯軍的計畫是口袋式的伏擊：馬利克·本·阿夫夫先於前夜親自進谷勘察，四千名伏兵藏在谷中狹窄處與兩側高坡，先以石塊擲擾，再以單人襲擊各個落單者。第二段是潰退：穆斯林三百人的駱駝騎兵前鋒先進谷，隨即被高處落下的箭石擊中，人馬驚散，前鋒折回衝垮本軍陣腳，後隊在夜色中被衝得七零八落；先知周圍只剩下數十名近衛與輔士拼死護住人圈，退路一度斷絕。第三段是回身：穆罕默德下令全軍返回戰場，下令各部收攏人馬重整，輔士與遷士的步兵線重新站住，這是全場的轉折點。第四段是迂回：卡里德趁主力纏鬥之際率騎兵沿谷後的隘道繞出，直插伏兵背後，伏兵腹背受敵，陣腳大亂。第五段是追擊與掃尾：聯軍各部被分割逃散，一部分退往歐塔斯，一部分退入塔伊夫；追兵一路奔至納赫拉，杜萊德·本·西瑪在途中被殺；其後穆斯林圍攻塔伊夫約六日，用投石與壕溝對付羊角形大盾，因守軍抵抗到底而撤圍。
tacticsEn: The course of the battle can be broken into five stages. The first is the march. About two weeks after the fall of Mecca the Muslim army set out from Mecca and went into the hills of the Hijaz along the road to Taif, and after three or four days of marching it reached Hunayn on the night of the tenth of Shawwal. The confederation's plan was a pocket ambush. Malik ibn 'Awf entered the valley by night to look it over in person, and four thousand men were hidden in the narrows of the valley and on the high ground to either side, to begin by throwing stones and then to attack individual men one at a time. The second stage is the collapse. The Muslim vanguard of three hundred camel riders entered the valley first and was immediately hit by arrows and stones from the heights; the men and mounts panicked, the vanguard wheeled back and trampled its own rear, and the rest of the army was broken up in the darkness. Only a few tens of companions and Ansaris remained around the Prophet, holding a ring of bodies around him, and the line of retreat was cut for a time. The third stage is the turn about. Muhammad ordered the army back to the field, ordered each unit to gather its men and reform, and the infantry line of the Ansar and the emigrants stood firm again; this was the turning point of the day. The fourth stage is the flanking movement. While the main bodies were locked together, Khalid led the cavalry out through the pass behind the valley and drove straight into the rear of the ambushers, who were then taken between two fronts and came apart. The fifth stage is the pursuit and the mopping up. The confederation split and fled in fragments, some towards Autas and some into Taif. The pursuit ran as far as Nakhlah, where Durayd ibn al-Simma was killed. The Muslims then besieged Taif for about six days, using stone-throwing engines and a ditch against the horn-shaped shields, and lifted the siege because the defenders held out.
data: 可核對的數字要分等級看待。傳統編年（伊本·伊斯哈克傳本、伊本·希沙姆《先知傳記》、塔巴里《歷史》第九卷）記載：穆斯林一萬二千人，其中一萬人自麥地那同行、兩千人為新歸附的麥加人；敵方聯軍約兩萬人；馬利克投入谷中的伏兵四千；前鋒三百人。戰果方面，穆斯林陣亡者傳統記載從個位數到數十人不等，戰爭列表所附的戰果欄列四人；敵方陣亡記為赫瓦辛七十人、薩卡夫三百人，蘇萊姆另有一部分，俘虜六千人，繳獲駱駝二萬四千頭、山羊四萬頭，這批數字來自較早的歐洲轉述，學界多視為誇大。地理上，胡奈的經緯度約在北緯21度26分、東經40度21分，位於麥加以東約五、六十公里的塔伊夫路上，傳統記載的行軍歷時三至四天，可與此對照。日期方面，本卡沿用戰爭列表所載的西元630年（伊斯蘭曆8年）說法，而通行編年把此役定在伊斯蘭曆10年8月，即西元632年11月20日，兩者相差約兩年，現代研究多指出戰爭列表的年代取自一種較早的年表。關於《古蘭經》第九章25節那段以「胡奈之戰」命名的經文，是整部經卷中少數直接提及戰役名稱的段落之一。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked have to be sorted by reliability. The traditional narratives (the transmitted text of Ibn Ishaq, Ibn Hisham's Sira, and volume IX of al-Tabari's History) give twelve thousand Muslims, of whom ten thousand had come from Medina and two thousand were newly converted Meccans; about twenty thousand for the confederation; four thousand men placed in the valley by Malik; and a vanguard of three hundred. On the results, the Muslim dead are recorded in the traditional sources as ranging from single figures to several tens, while the casualties box in the war list gives four; the enemy dead are given as seventy Hawazin and three hundred Thaqif with more from Sulaym, six thousand prisoners, and twenty-four thousand camels and forty thousand goats captured, and these last figures come from older European transcriptions that scholars generally treat as inflated. Geographically, Hunayn lies at about 21 degrees 26 minutes north and 40 degrees 21 minutes east, some fifty or sixty kilometres east of Mecca on the road to Taif, which is consistent with the traditional three or four days of marching. As for the date, this card follows the war list, which gives 630 CE (8 AH), while the standard chronology places the battle on the eighth of Dhu al-Hijjah in 10 AH, that is 20 November 632; the two differ by about two years, and modern studies point out that the date in the war list comes from an earlier chronology. The passage of Quran 9:25 that names the battle of Hunayn is one of the few passages in the whole text to name a battle explicitly.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最外層是部落宿怨：赫瓦辛與其盟友薩卡夫長期與麥加為敵，菲嘉爾戰爭留下的血仇未了，爭的是通往伊拉克希拉的商路與牧場；塔伊夫石城易守，是薩卡夫的根據地。第二層是政治形勢：麥加陷落後，麥加舊貴族失去權位，麥地那的政權接管了麥加，赫瓦辛各部看到的是又一個強大的古萊什領袖崛起，寧可先下手。第三層是聯盟自己的算盤：馬利克·本·阿夫夫在各部之間遊說，認為人多勢眾足以一戰，而且把家眷、牲畜與攻城器械都帶進山谷，準備在談判破裂時以人質與財產作籌碼。穆斯林這邊的起因則是追擊：穆罕默德沒有給赫瓦辛喘息之機，麥加陷落後兩週便率軍出發，目標直指塔伊夫。宗教層面上，這也是新共同體第一次檢驗自己能否把宗教凝聚轉成軍隊的組織力——戰後《古蘭經》第九章25節所點出的「你們因人多而自傲，人多對你們毫無裨益」，正是對這場仗的判詞。
causeEn: There are three layers of cause. The outermost is tribal enmity: the Hawazin and their allies the Thaqif had long been enemies of Mecca, the blood of the wars of Fijar was still unpaid, and the stake was the trade road to al-Hirah in Iraq together with the grazing lands. Taif, a stone city and hard to hold, was the Thaqif base. The second layer is political. After the fall of Mecca the old Meccan aristocracy lost its position and the government from Medina took Mecca over; what the Hawazin tribes saw was the rise of yet another powerful Qurayshi leader, and they preferred to strike first. The third layer is the confederation's own arithmetic. Malik ibn 'Awf travelled among the tribes, arguing that their numbers were enough to win, and they brought their families, their flocks and their siege engines into the valley so that, if the talks broke down, they would have hostages and property in hand. On the Muslim side the cause was pursuit. Muhammad gave the Hawazin no breathing space: two weeks after the fall of Mecca he marched out with the target of Taif itself. At the religious level this was also the first time the new community tested whether religious solidarity could be turned into the organisation of an army, and the words of Quran 9:25 afterwards, that you were proud of your great numbers and that they were of no advantage to you, are the verdict on the day itself.
impact: 胡奈的影響主要落在三個方向。第一是軍事學的層面：此役之後，穆斯林軍隊的兩大兵種分工被固定下來——以長矛與大盾為核心的步兵線負責站住與糾纏，以卡里德那樣的騎兵迂回負責破陣；繞出谷後隘道攻擊敵軍背後的這一手，成為後世伊斯蘭兵書裡反覆引用的經典，與古典兵法中「正面牽制、側後迂迴」的分離突擊同一邏輯。第二是制度的層面：勝後圍於戰利品歸屬的爭執——艾布·卡塔達先斬後奏，艾布·伯克爾當眾說「真主的使者不會把戰利品賜給真主的獅子所殺之人」——最終引出「由領袖指定分配」的原則，私有戰利品與公有戰利品的分野由此開始成形；赫瓦辛與薩卡夫各部隨後取得的保護性條約（《古蘭經》第九章28至29節所載之「安全」）也讓穆斯林政權與非阿拉伯部落的關係有了第一份成文安排。第三是長遠的：這場勝利讓新生的穆斯林政權在劫掠之外第一次嘗試組織常備的步兵與騎兵協同，雖然隨後爆發第一次內戰，但軍隊的骨架已經搭起來，歐塔斯之戰與塔伊夫之圍都沿用同一套打法。
impactEn: The consequences of Hunayn fell in three directions. The first is military. After this battle the division of labour between the two arms of the Muslim army was fixed: an infantry core of spears and large shields whose job was to stand and to hold the enemy, and cavalry of the kind Khalid commanded whose job was to strike the flank. The move of riding out through the pass behind the valley and hitting the enemy in the rear became a classic cited again and again in later Islamic military writing, and it follows the same logic as the classic division of effort between holding the front in place and turning the flank. The second is institutional. The dispute over the spoils after the victory, in which Abu Qatada had struck first and claimed his right and Abu Bakr declared in public that the Messenger of God would not hand the spoil to a man slain by the Lions of God, ended in the principle that the distribution of the spoil is assigned by the leader, and with it the dividing line between private spoil and public spoil began to take shape. The protective treaties obtained afterwards by the Hawazin and the Thaqif, the 'security' of Quran 9:28 to 9:29, gave the Muslim government its first written arrangement for its relations with the non-Arab tribes. The third is the long term. This victory was the first time the new Muslim authority tried, beyond plunder, to organise a standing cooperation of infantry and cavalry, and although the first civil war followed soon after, the frame of the army was now in place, and the Battle of Autas and the siege of Taif both used the same methods.
result: 結果是穆斯林勝，但過程先敗後勝。開戰當夜，聯軍的伏兵與石襲擊垮了穆斯林的前鋒與中軍，前衛崩潰、大批士兵趁夜逃散，先知本人一度被圍在不足百人的圈子裡，兵敗的場面毫無掩飾。逆轉來自兩件事：步兵在穆罕默德下令後重新集結站住，以及卡里德率騎兵繞到伏兵背後發動襲擊。聯軍一旦失去口袋，士氣與陣形同步崩壞，各部各自逃命，一部分退往歐塔斯（其後另有一戰），一部分退入塔伊夫；追兵在納赫拉追上並殺死老將杜萊德·本·西瑪。穆斯林隨後占據胡奈堡壘，取用其攻城器與糧秣，圍塔伊夫約六日，因城牆以羊角形大盾護衛、守軍抵抗到底而未能破城，遂解圍而歸。此役之後，穆斯林以二萬四千頭駱駝、四萬頭山羊與大量武器為繳獲，並以俘虜與牲畜作為換取和平的籌碼；赫瓦辛與薩卡夫各部得到的不是刀兵之下的結果，而是由條款確定的保護安排，聯盟也由此瓦解。史家常以此役說明穆罕默德時期的軍事藝術：人數從來不是關鍵，站得住的步兵線加上繞到背後的騎兵，才是真正決定勝負的東西——這正是卡面那根斯巴達長矛要說的事。
resultEn: The result was a Muslim victory, but the process was a defeat first and a victory after. On the night the fight opened, the ambush and the stone-fall of the confederation broke the Muslim vanguard and the centre of the line; the leading troops collapsed, large numbers of men scattered into the dark, and the Prophet himself was for a time shut inside a ring of fewer than a hundred men, with the army's defeat showing plainly. Two things reversed it: the infantry re-forming and standing firm on the Prophet's order, and the blow struck by Khalid's cavalry at the rear of the ambushers. Once the pocket was lost, the morale and the formations of the confederation broke together, each tribe saving itself, some towards Autas, where there was to be another battle, and some into Taif. The pursuit ran to Nakhlah, where the old man Durayd ibn al-Simma was caught and killed. The Muslims then occupied the fortress of Hunayn and took its siege engines and stores, and they besieged Taif for about six days; the city wall, guarded by horn-shaped shields, and the stubbornness of the defenders kept them out, so they lifted the siege and withdrew. After the fight the Muslims had twenty-four thousand camels, forty thousand goats and a great quantity of arms as spoil, and prisoners and livestock became the means of buying peace. The Hawazin and the Thaqif were not given the result of the sword but protective arrangements fixed in clauses, and the confederation came apart. Historians of the campaigns of Muhammad usually cite Hunayn for a single lesson: numbers were never the thing that mattered. The infantry line that could hold its ground, together with cavalry that got round to the back, decided the day. That is the point the dory on the card is making.
